scientific.integrity: The theorem and the pi-separable corollary are proved symbolically from the stated closure axioms. No finite computation is used as a substitute for the universal argument.
scientific.limitations: No necessity of the closure axioms is claimed. An equivalent theorem may exist in formation or Fitting-class literature under different terminology; targeted searches found no such statement. The claim is an abstraction and extension of the proof mechanism in arXiv:2610.03151v1.

title: Normalizer divisibility for extension-closed generated-pair classes
